gaps.requirement: GOTS certification must be current and under active surveillance for organic-cotton product lines shipped to EU/UK buyers. Expired certificates are not accepted by accredited buyers.
gaps.factory_status: EXPIRED — GOTS certificate expired 30 Nov 2025. Six months lapsed without renewal. Affects organic-cotton lines shipped to NordStyle Group and M&S.
gaps.recommendation: Book GOTS renewal audit with Control Union immediately. Notify NordStyle Group and M&S of certification gap and remediation plan.

gaps.requirement: Establish and implement a due diligence policy identifying human rights and environmental risks. Policy must be published — DRAFT status does not satisfy the directive requirement.
gaps.factory_status: DRAFT — CSDDD supply chain due diligence narrative exists as internal draft as of 2026-04-05 but has not been published or formally adopted by management.
gaps.recommendation: Finalise, board-approve, and publish the due diligence report before CSDDD Phase 1 enforcement date.

gaps.requirement: Lead content in textile dyes must not exceed 50 ppm per OEKO-TEX Standard 100 and EU REACH Annex XVII restrictions.
gaps.factory_status: NON_CONFORMANT — chemical lab report shows lead in dyes at 78 ppm, exceeding the 50 ppm OEKO-TEX limit by 56%.
gaps.recommendation: Switch to REACH-compliant dye suppliers. Commission SGS or Intertek full SVHC panel test.

gaps.requirement: BSCI (Business Social Compliance Initiative) audit is required by BritMart Retail's commercial Code of Conduct for all tier-1 suppliers. Without it, factory is ineligible for PO renewal.
gaps.factory_status: MISSING — BSCI certification not held. No audit has been commissioned or scheduled.
gaps.recommendation: Register with amfori BSCI platform and commission initial BSCI audit through accredited audit body.

contradictions.claim: Factory is ISO 14001 compliant — effluent fully within legal limits
contradictions.evidence: water_effluent_discharge = 11.5 ppm (EU REACH limit: 8 ppm) — exceeds limit by 44%
contradictions.impact: The ISO 14001 / REACH compliance claim cannot hold while measured effluent exceeds the 8 ppm ceiling by 44%.

contradictions.impact: A 13-hour gap between self-reported and audited hours undermines the reliability of the factory's labour disclosures.
